criteria: Luxury is reserved for visually extravagant designs: substantial sculpture, intricate ornamentation, dense floral cascades or dramatic tiered construction. Basic piped hearts, ribbon-bow birthday cakes, small floral cakes and modest finishes are excluded after visual review. Tier count or the word luxury alone does not qualify a cake.
scope: Luxury collection membership only; other existing placements and product pages remain available.
